subject.title: [Feature]: Run channel command and session-context QA through canonical scenarios

question: Should maintainers land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101080 as the canonical implementation for this QA scenario migration?
rationale: This issue is maintainer-authored, protected by the `maintainer` label, and already has an open closing PR, so the remaining choice is maintainer review of that implementation rather than a new cleanup close or automated fix lane.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Treat the open PR as the active implementation path for this issue and close the issue only after it merges.

options.title: Revise the linked PR in place

options.title: Close the linked PR and keep the issue
